text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...It looks like the Great Harvest Festival
is drawing to a close soon."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
They ate almost all of it, but...
we do have just a tiny bit of ingredients left over.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The food everywhere else was delicious too!
I was surprised when I went snac—er, scouting!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Well, look at it this way. Isn't it all about perspective?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You were thinking it too, weren't you?
...That our cooking looks delicious, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ace-san... were you an ESPer?!
We've known each other for so long, yet I had no idea...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, to celebrate today's wrap-up!
I'm gonna cook something super-duper buono~!

The food was nearly sold out.
And in the end, they spent a modestly fun and delicious time together.
